blurb: I am honored to serve as the Museum's President and look forward to another great year of community participation. We are excited to announce that our Santa Paula Aviation Career Exploring (SP-ACE) program is now affiliated with Scouting USA. The scouting program provides additional benefits and resources to our "SP-ACE kids" to help them develop their aviation skills and interests.
